dv_symmetry_declaration.ARM_SHUFFLED: same domain manipulation, recency mass on a NON-incumbent. Same argument, NOT invariant. Near-zero conversion here is the specificity control working, not a measured null; it is recorded as first-class criterion C5 rather than a footnote.
